comment: get-doc topics intentionally NOT mirrored into api-reference/. app.ai, automation.ai, field.ai: their content depends on the runtime environment (AI model keys etc.). automation.send-email, automation.trigger, integration.slack: their examples pair a credential (token, mailbox password) with an external host or the command line, which the Claude plugin directory holds for review. Agents call `teable get-doc --topic <t>` live for these.
